ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A truck and a passenger car are traveling in the same lane on a highway, with the passenger car in front and the truck behind. Suddenly an emergency situation occurs, and the two vehicles brake at the same time. At the beginning of braking, the two vehicles are 30 m apart, and the v-t graph of the two vehicles during braking is shown in the figure. According to the graph, will the two vehicles have a rear-end collision? If so, does the rear-end collision occur before the passenger car stops or after it stops?
ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: The two vehicles will have a rear-end collision after the passenger car stops
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Graph description: The v-t graph in the figure has two straight lines. The vertical axis is velocity v/(m·s^-1), and the horizontal axis is time t/s. The straight line labeled “passenger car” decreases linearly from t=0, v=40 m/s to t=20 s, v=0; the straight line labeled “truck” decreases linearly from t=0, v=30 m/s to t=30 s, v=0. The two straight lines intersect at t=10 s, the velocity at the intersection is about 20 m/s, and a dashed line marks t=10 s. Reasoning: 0 to 20 s is the process before the passenger car stops. The passenger car's displacement equals the triangular area under its v-t graph: s passenger=1/2×20×40=400 m. The truck's velocity from 0 to 20 s decreases from 30 m/s to 10 m/s, and its displacement equals the trapezoid area: s truck=(30+10)/2×20=400 m. Therefore by the time the passenger car stops, the truck has not traveled 30 m more than the passenger car, so there will be no rear-end collision before the passenger car stops; at this time the distance between the two vehicles is still 30 m. After 20 s the passenger car is stationary, and the truck still continues to decelerate from 10 m/s until stopping at 30 s. The truck's remaining displacement from 20 s to 30 s is the triangular area: s=1/2×10×10=50 m. Because 50 m > 30 m, the truck will catch up with the already stopped passenger car before it stops, so the rear-end collision occurs after the passenger car stops.
